title: 150,000 Cliff Buddhas: Yungang's Giants or Longmen's Thousands? | China Travel Expert
description:
Two Chinese cliffs hold around 150,000 carved Buddhas between them — which one wins?

Yungang, outside Datong in Shanxi, has 252 caves and about 51,000 statues, carved from the 5th century and a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2001. Longmen, along the river in Luoyang, Henan, records 2,345 caves and niches holding more than 100,000 statues, and was inscribed in 2000. Yungang goes big with early, monumental Buddhas; Longmen overwhelms with sheer numbers packed across the cliff face.

🧭 Expert Tip: both are easy half-day trips by high-speed rail — pair Yungang with Datong's Hanging Temple, and Longmen with Luoyang's old town, so one grotto day covers two sights.
